errors.evidence: The description states that the visual arrangement starts in the upper left corner with the smallest age group. However, the sector in the upper left corner is for the '65+' age group (14%), while the smallest age group '14-17' (5%) is located in the upper right.

errors.text_span: Секторът за възрастова група 14-17 е в тъмносин цвят
errors.evidence: The description uses 'тъмносин' (dark blue) to describe the color for the 14-17 age group. In the chart, this slice is a medium blue, while the '65+' slice is a much darker navy blue, which the description also calls 'тъмносин'. This creates an ambiguous and inaccurate color description for the 14-17 slice.

The description incorrectly identifies the '65+' age group, which accounts for 14%, as the largest sector. The largest sector in the pie chart corresponds to the '25-34' age group, which makes up 20% of the total.
